caption: Opening film: a real humanoid running HOIST guides a suspended box toward its target.
description: A real Unitree G1 humanoid running HOIST faces a gray box suspended from slings above a wooden platform with an outlined target. As the box is lowered, the robot reaches forward and pushes it with its hands, and the box lands on the platform. Fully autonomous, at original speed, without audio.
source: The authors' supplementary hoist.mp4, 23–45 seconds, HOIST panel only.
changes: Excerpted, resized, and H.264 compressed. Original playback speed; no audio.

people.description: Workers in hard hats and high-visibility vests guide a precast concrete footing suspended from crane slings onto a prepared concrete slab. They walk beside it with their hands on it as it is lowered. Close views then show workers crouched against the footing, pressing it with gloved hands to seat it on its guide hardware.
